facts.fact: The communique of the Abuja stakeholders' meeting (IPC, PLAC, YIAGA Africa) treats the Freedom of Information Act as the law in force, with 14 years of implementation, and says a Supreme Court judgment of 11 April 2025 confirmed it applies to state-level public institutions.

systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Justice / Attorney-General of the Federation

NGA.note: The document is about the FOI Act and says nothing on accessibility for persons with disabilities.
The document says nothing on local government office connections.
